authored_during: main generation; after frozen protocol and exporter; before main judgments/results
timing: technical decomposition authored after generation began; executed only after generation, primary judging, recheck, aggregation and original export completed
scope: measurement decomposition, cost arithmetic, terminology aliases and safe numeric serialization only
unit_costs: physical model calls and unique judge attempt IDs assigned through private blind mapping; no response IDs, text, tool arguments or returns published
unknowns: unknown measurements and costs remain null; known partial sums separate; no-request phase is known zero, labelled by request count and recheck selection
handoffs: legacy total includes coordinator bootstrap and inter-specialist peer delegations; peer-only is payload.from in faq/stock/attachments
specialists: tool attempts, actual child agent invocations, physical-model-bearing children and explicit returns are separate; no domain consultation inferred from specialist names
judgment_alias: valid_judgments is schema validity, not internally consistent assessment or task success
physical_judge_format: first_attempt_schema_valid excludes any recorded local deterministic repair; repaired raw responses remain first-attempt invalid, with normalized logical validity reported separately; provider format-repair requests are additional physical requests, never replacement first judgments
logical_judge_dispositions: logical_response_valid means a schema-valid persisted evaluation (possibly internally inconsistent); logical_response_invalid means a preserved evaluation-failure disposition, including schema, provider or interruption failures; logical_response_missing has no terminal disposition; these categories never replace task labels
referral_scope: safe numeric concordance of observed recommendation against technical labels supplied by common input policy; no autonomous clinical detection or clinical validation claim

pricing.inference_profile_scope: US geographic cross-region (us.*), standard on-demand; no batch discount
pricing.meaning: estimate from publicly listed standard geographic cross-region rates, not AWS billing or account-specific discounts; usage missing => full cost unknown
pricing.cache: no prompt cache configured; any recorded cache usage must be reported separately and not priced silently as base input

judge_dispatch_amendment.judgment_time_boundary: separate from sequential generation core and collector latency
judge_dispatch_amendment.physical_accounting: per-owner journals and canonical journals are views of the same requests; count each physical request once
